retrieval.rag_summary:
Stinger Accessory encompasses the proprietary collated
fasteners, plastic caps, and maintenance components manufactured for STINGER cap
systems by National Nail Corp. Centered on the StaplePac and NailPac product
lines, these accessories deliver full 25mm (1 inch) diameter plastic caps
alongside staples or ring-shank nails. By spreading the fastening load and
sealing out moisture, they prevent wind blow-offs, tearing, and lateral slippage
of housewrap and roofing underlayments across residential jobsites.
